title: Florida Senate, District 10
what_it_does: Represents District 10 in the Florida Senate; votes on state laws and the state budget.
verified_ballot_note: Florida Politics reports John Lowndes of Maitland won the Aug. 18, 2026 Democratic primary with 71% over H. Alexander Duncan and will face incumbent Republican Sen. Jason Brodeur of Sanford on Nov. 3 (https://floridapolitics.com/archives/815694-john-lowndes-wins-democratic-primary-in-sd-10-turns-attention-to-jason-brodeur/); ClickOrlando's voter guide confirms the district (Seminole and part of Orange). Research limitation (Sept 2026): Ballotpedia, Wikipedia, dos.fl.gov, floridaelectionwatch.gov, Florida Politics and all news sites were blocked for fetching in this sandbox and the WebSearch budget was capped, so the roster is built only from search-result snippets; write-in/NPA qualifiers could not be checked. Positions are null because no snippet contained an explicit issue statement.

candidates.name: Jason Brodeur
candidates.photo_source: Florida Senate member page (portrait image URL not verified; site blocked in sandbox)
candidates.background: Brodeur, of Sanford, has represented SD 10 (formerly SD 9) in the Senate since 2020 after serving in the Florida House; he declared for the Aug. 18, 2026 Republican primary.
